An '''adamant dolabra''' is a [[dolabra]] of the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tier, made by smithing a diamond axe with [[adamant alloy]] and a [[smithing upgrade template]]. It is a smelting pickaxe and axe in one.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[smithing upgrade template]]; without one, the same diamond axe and alloy make an [[adamant axe]]. Because recipes match by item ID, a diamond dolabra works as the base as well.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe and axe blocks at speed {{Value|Adamant Dolabra|miningspeed}} and obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests at speed 55, with {{Value|Adamant Dolabra|durability}} durability.

Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Intrinsics ===
Efficiency I, Unbreaking II and smelting. The smelting intrinsic makes mined blocks drop their smelted form where the block's loot table supports it: metal ores drop ingots or [[silver bullion]], quartz deposits drop glass, logs drop charcoal, sand drops glass and cobblestone drops [[limestone]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/sand.json}}</ref> Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Adamant Dolabra|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Adamant Dolabra|attackspeed}}. Unlike the adamant axe it does not inflict Weakness.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[adamant scrap]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one [[adamant alloy]], returning the alloy but losing the diamonds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
{{Uses}}

An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_dolabra.json}}</ref>
